verdict_reason: S1/S2 imagery is open on GEE, but the ground truth (geolocated CCE plot linked to its PMFBY insurance unit) lives only inside the government DGCES/PMFBY portal, gated behind enumerator mobile-OTP login. No public API, dataset, or researcher-access route was found; both PMFBY landing pages refused connection.

compute_path.why: All S1/S2 pulling and time-series compositing runs server-side in GEE; no sustained local GPU needed, well under C9's compute ceiling.
